name: Kawasaki (Miyagi, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kawasaki town emblem in white: concentric rings enclosing the character 崎.
history: Municipal flag of Kawasaki, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1964.

features.role: Kawasaki town emblem — concentric rings enclosing the character 崎
